verdict.rationale: The SDK lets a main agent spawn programmatically defined subagents, including running analyses in parallel. Claude Code docs also mention agent teams and "dynamic workflows." However, orchestration is model-driven through the agent loop and lead-agent delegation, not an explicit developer-composed graph. Missing for 10: an explicit graph/workflow composition API, developer-defined branching and loop constructs, documentation of the "dynamic workflows" feature within the SDK, and independent corroboration.
